# Deploy the stack

## Procedure

1. Review the deployment requirements in [AGENTS.md](../../../AGENTS.md).
2. Verify required environment variables are set without printing secret values.
3. Validate the Compose configuration and deployment script before deploying.
4. Deploy only after confirming the target host and domain are correct.
5. Run the project smoke test and report its result.

Deployment tooling is not implemented yet.
